name: Kyochu Yona
source:
[i]"The boss is real smart. I'm an idiot, so I don't get what he's saying a lot of the time, but I know he's never wrong."[/i]

[i]Enforcer through Innocence[/i]

A Sodyk family capo. While not all that intelligent, he's powerful on the battlefield, and will execute any task given by Mun without any hesitation.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
